messages:
Maya: Who's up for 'Iron Lungs' week? 3 rounds of 60s wall-sits + 400m easy jog during lunch. tiny prize: office kombucha for the winner. :sweat_smile: 
Ollie: Wait does standing in the kitchen for 60s count as wall-sit? asking for a friend. :stuck_out_tongue:
Riley: lol no, wall required. I will join but i can only do 45s day 1. beginner mode.
Juno: I'm in. can we make the jog optional for people on call?
Maya: yes to scaled holds and jog optional. main rule: honesty + post a selfie or pace screenshot in the thread.
Ollie: @kudos-bot can we auto-collect entries?
kudos-bot: kudos-bot: Drop "IronLungs done" in this thread to log. Top 3 get :tada: reactions at the end of the week.
Riley: Also proposal: micro-bet 3 bucks each and winner buys kombucha. fair?
Juno: i'm poor but i'll chip in a granola bar instead :grin:
Maya: love it. starting Monday 12:15pm. i'll post a calendar event with reminder.
Ollie: Can someone share a quick wall-sit form tip? my knees complain.
Riley: Keep knees behind toes, back flat against wall, weight on heels. breathe.
Juno: And small tip: squeeze glutes to protect knees.
Maya: Great. See you Monday. May the best wall hold win :muscle:
